notes.subject: Ash · Kesil · Kimah
notes.rationale: Dolow tɔgɔw (constellations) bɛ to tɔgɔ ye, i n'a fɔ Heburukan b'u wele cogo min na; As (Doloba), Kesil (Orion), Kimah (Pleiyadew)

notes.subject: עשה עש
notes.rationale: asah (a dilan) ni Ash (doloba tɔgɔ) — taamasiyɛn bɛɛɛni min ka bon ni kan ye, a bɛ bayɛlɛmali na dun

notes.subject: עש
notes.rationale: Ash (doloba tɔgɔ) bɛ Tanaki kɔnɔ ninnu dɔrɔn: Job 9:9 ni Job 38:32

translation: Min bɛ Ash ni Kesil ni Kimah dilan, ani worodugu ka sobaw.
